# BenchBox Media

> BenchBox Media (legal name BENCH BOX MEDIA LLP) is a full-service marketing, advertising and production agency in Indiranagar, Bengaluru (Bangalore), India. One team handles strategy, media planning and buying, PR, branding, content, influencer marketing, ad films and TVCs, AI ad films and AI brand films, websites, apps and events. Contact: marketing@benchboxmedia.com · +91 6361 772 547 (call or WhatsApp).

Key facts:
- Based in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka; works with brands across India and worldwide.
- 100+ brands, 200+ PR campaigns, 150+ launches and activation events, 500+ films and visual content, 3000+ static creatives, 20+ websites.
- Brands worked with include Coca-Cola, Adidas, IKEA, HP, Honda, Uber, Zomato, Tanishq, Britannia, TVS, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Sebamed, Dot & Key and XYXX.
- Produces in English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu and Malayalam.
- AI studio: AI brand films, AI ad films and TVCs, AI product visuals and AI social content. Original AI short film: "Before You Delete" (https://youtu.be/gluIIuQbOnM).
- BenchBox Labs is its tech studio for websites, iOS and Android apps, SaaS, web apps, AI chatbots and automation.
